task.title: Build parallel merge publisher queue
task.summary: Build a serialized publisher queue that compares worker diffs, validates outputs, commits safe merges, and reroutes conflicts after parallel worktree execution.

goal.outcome: Parallel worker outputs are merged through a serialized publisher queue that checks diffs, enforces validation proof, commits safely, and routes conflicts back to workers or planning.
acceptance: Publisher queue ingests worker build/validation refs and worktree diff proofs.
Merge validator compares diffs for overlap/conflicts, reruns required audits/checks, and blocks unsafe merges.
Successful merges create local checkpoint/close commits with task/build/validation/tree proof.
Conflicts produce deterministic wait/reroute evidence and wake affected workers when resolved.
Tests cover clean merge, conflict, validation failure, stale base, close proof, and no remote publication without approval.
non_goals: Do not push to remote without explicit user approval.
Do not replace Git history as the source of merge truth.
Do not merge unvalidated worker outputs.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Publisher queue ingests worker build/validation refs and worktree diff proofs.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/session/worker-diff.ts normalizes WorkerDiffProof with task/build/validation/base/head/tree/worktree/branch/changed_files/checks/clean/digest; src/session/merge-publisher-queue.ts accepts worker proofs and emits evidence build_refs/validation_refs/diff_digests.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Merge validator compares diffs for overlap/conflicts, reruns required audits/checks, and blocks unsafe merges.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: detectWorkerDiffConflicts catches file overlap, duplicate task output, and stale base; planMergePublisherQueue blocks validation-not-pass, dirty worker, missing proof, missing required checks, remote publication without approval, and incomplete publisher proof. Tests cover conflict, validation failure, stale base, missing checks, and remote approval.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Successful merges create local checkpoint/close commits with task/build/validation/tree proof.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/session/publisher-proof.ts builds PublisherProof with publisher base/head/tree, task/build/validation/diff/check refs, safe_to_commit, and commit_plan commands/body/required_proof. Clean merge test asserts local_commit.allowed and commit proof body.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Conflicts produce deterministic wait/reroute evidence and wake affected workers when resolved.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: planMergePublisherQueue emits reroutes per affected worker with wait action/scopes and wake_on_resolution source_refs/next_action_intent. Conflict test asserts reroute wait and wake intent.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Tests cover clean merge, conflict, validation failure, stale base, close proof, and no remote publication without approval.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/smoke/merge-publisher-queue.test.mjs covers clean merge, file conflict, validation failure, stale base, incomplete close proof/missing checks, remote publication blocked without approval, and approved remote publication flag behavior.
